messages:
mara (marketing): Quick kickoff for Solaris Cloud co-marketing. Deliverables: marketplace listing, benchmark blog, and a joint webinar. Need owners + timelines.

diego (partnerships): Solaris can provide a customer quote and logo. They want the marketplace feature the week after the webinar. I'll handle approvals.

anya (growth): Proposed webinar Thu Jun 10 9am PT. Format: 30m dual demo + 15m Q&A. Need compact reg form (6 fields) and a gated benchmark PDF.

ben (content): I'll draft the benchmark narrative. Eng, can you run a 6k-token mixed workload (chat + summarization + retrieval) and share p50/p95, tokens/s, and cost/1M tokens across fp16 and int8? Also need a sanitized CSV.

mina (eng-ml): On it. Will run tests and deliver metrics + short methods note with model commit and batch sizes by Fri May 30. Raw logs will be sanitized.

lee (solutions): Redwood will demo Dedicated routing and the cost dashboard; Solaris will demo their managed scaling. Need a test tenant and an API key. Ops-bot, can you open the provisioning ticket?

ops-bot: Ticket created #PROV-5609 for test tenant + API key.

mara (marketing): Reg form fields suggested: name, email, company, role, demo_interest (yes/no), utm_campaign. demo_interest=yes -> route to SDR. Keep form short.

anya (growth): UTMs: utm_source=solaris_partner, utm_medium=partner_webinar, utm_campaign=solaris_launch. We'll push registrants to CRM with partner tag and create a webhook for Solaris partner-sales.

ben (content): Blog headlines options: "Measuring Predictable Inference: Redwood + Solaris" or "Lowering Inference TCO with Dedicated Serving + Solaris Managed Endpoints". I'll prepare the gated PDF layout and visuals.

diego (partnerships): Solaris legal wants the co-marketing agreement signed before publish. ETA 48-72 hours once I send.

mara (marketing): Timeline recap: Week -2 teaser, Week -1 benchmark blog (gated), Week 0 webinar, Week +1 recording + marketplace spotlight. Owners: webinar ops (anya), partner legal/assets (diego), perf (mina), content (ben), demo (lee), promo + landing (mara).

ben (content): I'll need a 1-2 sentence Solaris quote and a 1-2 sentence technical blurb from Mina by Tue Jun 1.

mina (eng-ml): Will add a short tech quote with the metrics.

mara (marketing): Great. I'll create the checklist doc and share the calendar invites. If anything blocks, call it out here. :sparkles:
